scope: Read-only descriptive extraction; no application execution, grading, new provider usage collection, or inferential cohort analysis.

definitions.model_responses: Completed responses in captured provider metadata; not all API requests or tool operations.
definitions.model_output_tokens: Application-window provider output, including reasoning output.
definitions.store_profile_operations: All operations retained in each profile, including await-handoff when present; not model rounds.
definitions.dashboard: Partial four-language projection, with totals over available telemetry and medians over sealed attempts, including failures.
definitions.sealed_pair_totals: Descriptive sums over pairs for which both arms are sealed. Incomplete cohorts and absent source reviews prevent a completed-cohort speed or quality conclusion.
